verdict.rationale: Asana's official MCP server explicitly supports natural-language task/project management, querying ("Find all my incomplete tasks due this week"), and report generation, and integrates with AI assistants like Claude for turning conversational input into actionable work. This is documented first-party with concrete examples, plus a Claude app integration further corroborating natural-language operation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user testimonials confirming reliability of natural-language commands in practice.
